name: mcp_sdk_eyra_accelerator
description: A standalone MCP server that exposes API endpoints as tools for AI assistants by proxying requests to a target API defined in an OpenAPI specification. It supports various authentication methods and utilizes Server-Sent Events (SSE) to facilitate integration with clients like Claude and ChatGPT.
